translation.text: Metra Rock Island Line Closure the Weekend of Nov. 13-15

Metra's Rock Island Line will close the weekend of Nov. 13-15 to accommodate the raising of a Metra railroad bridge at 79th Street in Chicago's Auburn Park neighborhood. 

The last outbound Rock Island mainline train will be Train 511 on Friday, Nov. 13 departing LaSalle Street Station at 8:25 p.m. The last inbound train will be Train 512 departing Joliet at 6:25 p.m. Service is scheduled to be restored Monday, Nov. 16. 

Visit Metra.com for more details.
RI The LaSalle Street Station CTA elevator is temporarily out of service.

The LaSalle Street Station CTA elevator is temporarily out of service. Recommended alternative located at LaSalle St. Station west elevator and East Escalators. Metra will provide updated information once service has been restored.

The ADA parking spaces at the station will be out of service from Monday, November 2 through Monday, November 23 for necessary repairs. Station construction is expected to continue through Spring 2027. Metra will provide updates once construction is complete.
ME The Van Buren Street Michigan Avenue elevator is out of service.
The Van Buren Street Michigan Avenue elevator is out of service. Customers can use Museum Campus/11th St or McCormick Place as alternate boarding stations.

MDW train #2252, scheduled to depart Big Timber Road/Elgin at 8:22 PM, will not operate due to  earlier vehicle struck by train. Train #2254, scheduled to depart Big Timber Road/Elgin at 9:22 PM will accommodate  passengers.

The South Water elevator is closed to all passengers during reconstruction. ADA passengers should use Van Buren Station for elevator access. For the latest service alerts and real-time info visit Metra.com/MEelevators.
ME The 51st/53rd Street/Hyde Park East elevator is back in service.
The 51st/53rd Street/Hyde Park East elevator is back in service.

The north/south parking lots at the 115th St/Morgan Park station are open to the public and ADA accessibility has been restored. Station construction is expected to continue through Spring 2027. Metra will provide updates once construction is complete.

UPW train #63 scheduled to arrive Elburn at 8:28 PM, is on the move and operating 20 to 25 minutes behind schedule due to earlier freight train interference. Visit metratracker.com for the location of your train.

UPNW train #669 scheduled to arrive Crystal Lake at 9:00 PM, may be operating 10 to 15 minutes behind schedule due to weather related conditions. Visit metratracker.com for the location of your train.

Effective, October 10, Union Pacific North line will be operating extra service before and after the Northwestern Football games at Ryan Field. In addition, passengers attending Northwestern football games will ride free when displaying their game tickets to onboard personnel. Visit metra.com for schedule information.
ME The Flossmoor elevator is back in service.
The Flossmoor elevator is back in service.

Your action is needed to continue to receive alerts after Nov. 5, when Metra will end its current alert system and launch an enhancement featuring email and/or text Service Alerts, as well as Prediction Alerts showing the next trains at your station. Enroll in the new service if you still want to receive alerts. To sign up, go to metratracker.com starting Nov. 5, create an account by clicking "Subscribe," and set up alerts by clicking "Alerts: Sign up for station information." Go to metra.com for details.
RID train #514, scheduled to depart Joliet at 7:25 PM, is operating 30 to 35 minutes behind schedule due to earlier police activity.

Platform construction will take place at the Morton Grove station beginning Monday, August 3 through Spring 2027. Please allow additional travel time and use caution near the work area during this time. Updates will be provided.
HC - Summit Station ADA Ramp Rehabilitation Project

Beginning Wednesday, September 16, the existing ADA ramp at the Summit Station will be temporarily out of service for rehabilitation and is expected to remain closed for approximately two months.  During this time, passengers using wheelchairs or requiring accessible access must use the existing ramp located at the southwest end of Platform 2 (inbound) to access boarding platforms.
